text:
maria-support: Escalating an urgent customer issue — org_id=org_77, request_id=req_a1b2. Customer reports duplicate tool executions and two charges. They say the client retried and got a fallback response but the tool still executed twice. Can eng + SRE help triage?

sam-eng: @olivia-sre can you pull the runtime logs for req_a1b2? suspect tool-call retry loop. :eyes:

olivia-sre: Pasted a trimmed log snippet below. Looks like initial tool call returned a schema validation 400 from the tool runtime, then the caller retried and we record two tool_exec events. Trace ids attached.

```
[2026-08-10T18:05:11Z] trace=req_a1b2 event=tool_call dispatched tool=payment_processor args_hash=0x7f4 status=400 reason="schema_validation: amount_cents should be integer"
[2026-08-10T18:05:11Z] trace=req_a1b2 event=ack_to_client delivered=false
[2026-08-10T18:05:12Z] trace=req_a1b2 event=retry scheduled by=client_attempt_2
[2026-08-10T18:05:12Z] trace=req_a1b2 event=tool_call dispatched tool=payment_processor args_hash=0x8c3 status=200 exec_id=exec_893
[2026-08-10T18:05:12Z] trace=req_a1b2 event=tool_call dispatched tool=payment_processor args_hash=0x8c3 status=200 exec_id=exec_894
```

maria-support: So the timeline seems to be: 1) client sends tool call with malformed arg (string instead of int), 2) tool runtime returns 400 validation, but client didn't get a clear ack (maybe timed out) and retried, 3) the retry ended up executing twice (exec_893 & exec_894) — hence duplicate charge. Billing spike and customer upset.

sam-eng: Do we have the original payload from the customer? Need to reproduce locally. Also what retry policy did the SDK use — exponential backoff? Which HTTP codes trigger retry?

maria-support: Customer pasted this request body in their ticket: 

```json
{"tool": "payment_processor", "args": {"amount_cents": "1000", "currency": "usd", "customer_id": "cus_99"}, "idempotency_key": null}
```

zach-ml: Notably idempotency_key is null. SDK should set one automatically but looks like their client is a custom integration. If the tool runtime allowed execution before strict schema acceptance or didn't dedupe on idempotency header, duplicates can happen.

olivia-sre: Repro steps I used: 
1) Send initial request with amount_cents as string and X-Request-Id=req_a1b2 header.
2) Simulate transient network drop right after request (tcp reset) so client doesn't get ack.
3) Resend same request without idempotency header. Observed two exec events within 1s window.

Command I used: 
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer REDWOOD_TEST" -H "X-Request-Id: req_a1b2" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"tool":"payment_processor","args":{"amount_cents":"1000","currency":"usd","customer_id":"cus_99"}}'
# during the tcp reset window resend the same curl
```

sam-eng: Thanks. Two things to fix ASAP: 1) short-term mitigation: add dedupe in the tool-executor service keyed by X-Request-Id and/or idempotency_key to prevent double execs within a short window, 2) longer-term: fail fast on schema validation before handing off to executor and return a deterministic 4xx so clients don't retry.

olivia-sre: Agreed. I'll open a quick hotfix PR to check schema at edge and ensure we return 400 with body {"error":"schema_validation","details":...} and NOT drop the connection. That should stop client retries caused by timeouts.

maria-support: Also let's propose a partial refund to the customer while we fix. Finance OK? I'll loop in billing.

sam-eng: For the dedupe change: implement a cache in tool-executor using (org_id, idempotency_key || X-Request-Id) with TTL 5m. If none provided, compute an args_hash and only dedupe if identical args and same request id — but warning that hash-only dedupe can be risky. We'll prefer explicit idempotency header.

zach-ml: We should also update SDK docs: require idempotency_key for any tool that performs side-effects (payment, send-email, etc.). Add automatic header generation in official SDKs.

olivia-sre: ops-bot reports a rolling deploy is queued. @sam-eng can you review the hotfix PR? ops-bot: "deploy/edge-schema-validation-hotfix queued by olivia-sre"

ops-bot: Deploy queued: deploy/edge-schema-validation-hotfix started by olivia-sre at 2026-08-10T18:20:00Z

sam-eng: Reviewing now. If tests pass, push to prod. Also add temporary metric alert: duplicate_tool_execs > 0 for any org -> page oncall.

maria-support: I'll draft the customer message: apology + refund + ETA for fix.

olivia-sre: Hotfix merged and deployed to prod at 2026-08-10T18:28:00Z. Early telemetry shows no repeat duplicates for incoming repro traffic.

sam-eng: Follow-up actions (tickets):
- ENG-2345: dedupe at tool-executor (prio P0)
- ENG-2346: SDK idempotency header + docs (P1)
- ENG-2347: add metric/alert for duplicate execs (P0)
- CS-889: customer refund + communication (maria-support)

maria-support: Thanks team. I'll mark customer escalated -> resolved once refund processed. :white_check_mark:

olivia-sre: Closing thread, will keep monitoring for 24h.
